name: @kitora/sidebar
description: Kitora's application sidebar: a framework-free nav model (tree, sections, badges, active matching, moves, persisted state) with React bindings, resize on the dock's SplitView, drag reorder on the dnd kit, and styled ClickUp / Slack / Linear / VS Code / Notion-grade presets.

exports.name: isMember
exports.description: True when `value` is one of `set`; narrows untrusted input without a cast.
exports.signature: <const S extends readonly string[]>(set: S, value: unknown) => value is S[number]

exports.name: SIDEBAR_SHAPES
exports.description: How the panel is drawn: flush to the edge, floating (inset, rounded, shadow) or inset (content card on the sidebar background).

exports.name: SidebarShape
exports.description: How the panel is drawn; one of `SIDEBAR_SHAPES`.

exports.name: SIDEBAR_SURFACES
exports.description: The panel's surface: opaque, or translucent so what is behind the layout shows through blurred (a macOS source list).

exports.name: SidebarSurface
exports.description: The panel's surface; one of `SIDEBAR_SURFACES`.

exports.name: ACTIVE_ROW_STYLES
exports.description: How the active row is marked: an accent-tinted fill with a full-height accent bar (`bar`, the default), the fill alone (`fill`, a macOS source list), or a neutral fill with a short accent pill (`pill`, a Windows 11 navigation pane).

exports.name: ActiveRowStyle
exports.description: How the active row is marked; one of `ACTIVE_ROW_STYLES`.

exports.name: COLLAPSE_MODES
exports.description: What "collapsed" means: an icon rail, a mini rail with tiny labels, hidden off canvas, or never collapsing.

exports.name: CollapseMode
exports.description: What "collapsed" means; one of `COLLAPSE_MODES`.

exports.name: PRESENTATIONS
exports.description: How an open panel meets the content: the content reflows (push) or is covered (overlay).

exports.name: Presentation
exports.description: How an open panel meets the content; one of `PRESENTATIONS`.

exports.name: SIDEBAR_SIDES
exports.description: Which edge, logically: `left` sits on the right edge under RTL.

exports.name: SidebarSide
exports.description: Which logical edge the sidebar sits on; one of `SIDEBAR_SIDES`.

exports.name: BANDS
exports.description: Responsive bands: a sheet on phones, the rail on tablets, the panel on desktops.

exports.name: Band
exports.description: A responsive band (phone, tablet, desktop); one of `BANDS`.

exports.name: DENSITIES
exports.description: Row density: compact power-user rows (28 px), comfortable (32 px), touch (44 px targets).

exports.name: Density
exports.description: Row density; one of `DENSITIES`.

exports.name: PRESENCES
exports.description: A person's presence, for DM rows and avatars.

exports.name: Presence
exports.description: A person's presence; one of `PRESENCES`.

exports.name: DOT_TONES
exports.description: Status dot tones.

exports.name: DotTone
exports.description: A status dot tone; one of `DOT_TONES`.

exports.name: MATCH_MODES
exports.description: How an item's href matches the current location.

exports.name: MatchMode
exports.description: How an item's href matches the current location; one of `MATCH_MODES`.

exports.name: SECTION_STATUSES
exports.description: A section's data state (S71, S73): its items, skeleton rows while loading, an error row with Retry.

exports.name: SectionStatus
exports.description: A section's data state; one of `SECTION_STATUSES`.

exports.name: SECTION_SORTS
exports.description: How a section orders its top-level items (S69): as the data has them (drag order), by label, or most recently visited first.

exports.name: SectionSort
exports.description: How a section orders its top-level items; one of `SECTION_SORTS`.

exports.name: DROP_POSITIONS
exports.description: Where a move lands relative to its target (the dnd kit's positions).

exports.name: DropPosition
exports.description: Where a move lands relative to its target; one of `DROP_POSITIONS`.

exports.name: defineNav
exports.description: Identity helper with inference: `defineNav([...])` keeps the literal shape and checks it.

exports.name: hasChildren
exports.description: True when the item has children to show or load.

exports.name: walkNav
exports.description: Calls `visit` for every item in pre-order with its section, parent and depth (1 for a section's top-level item).
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], visit: (item: NavItem<T>, at: { readonly section: NavSection<T>; readonly parent: NavItem<T> | null; readonly depth: number; }) => void) => void

exports.name: findItem
exports.description: The item with `id`, or null.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], id: string) => NavItem<T> | null

exports.name: sectionOf
exports.description: The section that holds item `id` (or is `id`), or null.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], id: string) => NavSection<T> | null

exports.name: ancestorIds
exports.description: The ids of `id`'s ancestor items, outermost first (sections not included); empty for a top-level item or an unknown id.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], id: string) => readonly string[]

exports.name: sortItems
exports.description: `items` in the order `sort` asks for (S69); the same array for `custom`. Items never visited sort after visited ones, by label.
exports.signature: <T>(items: readonly NavItem<T>[], sort: SectionSort | undefined, recents?: readonly string[]) => readonly NavItem<T>[]

exports.name: flattenNav
exports.description:
The rows of `sections` in display order: a header per labelled section, its
visible items in pre-order, a "Show more" row past the section's limit, and
an empty row for an empty section that has `empty` text.

exports.name: parentIds
exports.description: Every item id with children, in pre-order (for "expand all").

exports.name: favoriteItems
exports.description: Every favourite item, in nav order (S31): the source of a Favourites section when favourites are a flag.

exports.name: updateItem
exports.description: A copy of the nav with `update` applied to item `id` (rename, toggle favourite, new badge); unchanged when the id is unknown.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], id: string, update: (item: NavItem<T>) => NavItem<T>) => readonly NavSection<T>[]

exports.name: splitPinned
exports.description: The nav split into its pinned sections (S32, drawn in the sticky area above the scrolling body) and the rest, order kept.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[]) => { readonly pinned: readonly NavSection<T>[]; readonly rest: readonly NavSection<T>[]; }

exports.name: NavIcon
exports.description:
An item's icon, as data. `name` is looked up in the host's icon registry
(the react layer's `icons` prop); `emoji` draws the character; `initials`
draws a coloured tile (workspaces, teams, spaces); `src` is an image (an
avatar, a favicon). Absent: no icon (a leaf in a deep tree).

exports.name: NavBadge
exports.description:
What an item's badge says (S43–S45). Fields combine: Slack shows a bold
label (`unread`) and a mention pill (`mentions`) at once. `count` is a plain
count (Inbox 3, a list's open tasks); `mentions` is the urgent count drawn in
the accent colour; `dot` is a status dot; `text` is a short label ("New").

exports.name: NavMatch
exports.description: How an item's href matches the location (S121); default `prefix` for items with children, `exact` for leaves.

exports.name: NavItem
exports.description: One navigable item. `T` is the host's own payload, carried untouched.

exports.name: NavSection
exports.description: A section: a header and its items (S29–S32, S41).

exports.name: DEFAULT_SKELETON_ROWS
exports.description: Skeleton rows a loading section shows when it does not say (three reads as "a list", more as noise).

exports.name: NavRow
exports.description: One rendered row of a flattened nav.

exports.name: FlattenOptions
exports.description: What `flattenNav` reads besides the nav.

exports.name: isEmptyBadge
exports.description: True when the badge would draw nothing.

exports.name: mergeBadges
exports.description: Two badges merged: counts and mentions summed, unread or-ed, the more severe dot, the first text.
exports.signature: (a: NavBadge | undefined, b: NavBadge | undefined) => NavBadge

exports.name: rollupItem
exports.description: The badge of `item` merged with every descendant's (what a collapsed parent shows).

exports.name: rollupSection
exports.description: The badge of a whole section (a collapsed section header, a rail icon for that section).

exports.name: badgeText
exports.description: The badge as words, for the accessible name ("3 items, 1 mention, unread"); empty for no badge.

exports.name: formatCount
exports.description: A count for display: 99+ past `max` (default 99).

exports.name: BadgeMessages
exports.description: Messages for the accessible badge text; override for i18n (S113).

exports.name: DEFAULT_BADGE_MESSAGES
exports.description: The English badge messages `badgeText` uses when none are passed.

exports.name: normalizePath
exports.description: The path part of a location or href: no query, no hash, no trailing slash (except the root).

exports.name: matchesPattern
exports.description: True when `pathname` matches segment pattern `pattern` (`:param` one segment, trailing `*` the rest).

exports.name: matchScore
exports.description: How well `item` matches `pathname`: null for no match, else a score (higher wins); see the file header.

exports.name: matchActive
exports.description: The most specific match for `pathname` in `sections` (see the file header), or null.
exports.signature: (sections: readonly NavSection<unknown>[], pathname: string) => ActiveMatch | null

exports.name: itemsWithHref
exports.description: Every item whose href is `href` (the same page linked twice, from Favourites and from its space).
exports.signature: (sections: readonly NavSection<unknown>[], href: string) => readonly string[]

exports.name: ActiveMatch
exports.description: The active item for `pathname`, with its ancestors outermost first and its section; null when nothing matches.

exports.name: matchLabel
exports.signature: (label: string, query: string) => readonly MatchRange[] | null

exports.name: isEmptyFilter
exports.description: True when the filter keeps everything (no query text and no predicate).

exports.name: filterNav
exports.description: The nav filtered by `filter`; see the file header. With an empty filter the nav comes back unchanged.

exports.name: MatchRange
exports.description: A matched span of a label, `[start, end)` in UTF-16 units.

exports.name: NavFilterResult
exports.description: The filtered nav plus what the rows need to draw it.

exports.name: NavFilter
exports.description: What to filter by: a text query, an item predicate, or both (an item must pass both).

exports.name: locate
exports.description: The section that holds item `id` and the item's parent and index there; null for an unknown id.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], id: string) => NavDestination | null

exports.name: canDropAt
exports.description: True when `move` is allowed by the rules in the file header.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], move: NavMove, rules?: MoveRules<T>) => boolean

exports.name: destinationOf
exports.description: Where `move` would land (before the moved items are removed), or null when the target is unknown or the move makes no sense.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], move: NavMove) => NavDestination | null

exports.name: moveNavItems
exports.description:
The nav after `move`, or the same array when the move is refused by
`canDropAt` or changes nothing. Moved items keep their subtrees; several ids
move together in nav order, landing as one block.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], move: NavMove, rules?: MoveRules<T>) => readonly NavSection<T>[]

exports.name: siblingMove
exports.description: "Move up" / "Move down" for the keyboard and the menu (S98): the move that swaps `id` with its previous or next sibling, or null at the end.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], id: string, direction: "up" | "down") => NavMove | null

exports.name: applyMoves
exports.description:
`moves` replayed onto `sections` in order (S118): a host that stores the
user's moves as ops (local storage, its server) rebuilds the order on top of
the latest nav from its source. A move the rules refuse now (its item was
deleted, its target moved) is skipped rather than failing the rest.
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], moves: readonly NavMove[], rules?: MoveRules<T>) => readonly NavSection<T>[]

exports.name: NavMove
exports.description: A move: what moves and where it lands. `ids` are items or section ids (never both).

exports.name: NavDestination
exports.description: Where a move would put an item: the section, the new parent (null = top level) and the index among its new siblings.

exports.name: MoveRules
exports.description: Extra rules for `canDropAt` / `moveNavItems`.

exports.name: pushRecent
exports.description: `id` moved to the front of `list`, capped at `max` (S33).
exports.signature: (list: readonly string[], id: string, max?: number) => readonly string[]

exports.name: clampWidth
exports.description: Clamps a width to the expanded limits.
exports.signature: (width: number, min?: number, max?: number) => number

exports.name: reduceSidebar
exports.description: The pure transition; unchanged state comes back as the same object.

exports.name: createSidebarStore
exports.description: A store starting at `initial`; `onChange` sees every new state (persistence hooks in here).
exports.signature: (initial?: SidebarState, onChange?: (state: SidebarState, action: SidebarAction) => void) => SidebarStore

exports.name: DEFAULT_WIDTH_PX
exports.description: Default expanded width, px (between Linear's 220 and ClickUp's 280).

exports.name: MIN_WIDTH_PX
exports.description: Narrowest expanded width a drag may leave, px.

exports.name: MAX_WIDTH_PX
exports.description: Widest expanded width, px.

exports.name: RAIL_WIDTH_PX
exports.description: Icon rail width, px (Slack's and VS Code's rails are 48–72).

exports.name: RAIL_LABELS_WIDTH_PX
exports.description: Mini rail with tiny labels under the icons, px (Material's navigation rail, S3).

exports.name: RECENTS_MAX
exports.description: Recents kept (S33).

props.name: collapsed
props.description: The desktop panel is collapsed (to the rail or hidden, per the collapse mode).

props.name: mobileOpen
props.description: The phone sheet is open (separate from `collapsed`, S24).

props.name: width
props.description: Expanded width in px.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Item ids whose children show.

props.name: collapsedSections
props.description: Section ids the user collapsed.

props.name: showAll
props.description: Section ids showing all items past their limit.

props.name: hiddenSections
props.description: Section ids the user hid (S131).

props.name: panel
props.description: The view a double sidebar's rail selects (S82); null = the default.

props.name: recents
props.description: Most recently visited item ids, newest first (S33).

exports.name: INITIAL_SIDEBAR_STATE
exports.description: The state a fresh sidebar starts from: expanded at the default width, nothing open, hidden or recent.

exports.name: SidebarAction
exports.description: An action `reduceSidebar` applies to the sidebar state, dispatched through the store.

exports.name: SidebarStore
exports.description: A minimal external store over `reduceSidebar`.

exports.name: toSnapshot
exports.description: The snapshot of `state`.

exports.name: parseSnapshot
exports.description:
`raw` (a stored string, or an already-parsed value) as a state on top of
`base`; see the file header for the version rules.

exports.name: loadSidebar
exports.description: Reads `key` from `storage` (a throwing storage counts as empty: private mode, blocked cookies).
exports.signature: (storage: SidebarStorage, key: string, base?: SidebarState) => ParsedSnapshot

exports.name: saveSidebar
exports.description: Writes `state` to `storage` under `key`; a throwing storage (quota, private mode) is ignored.
exports.signature: (storage: SidebarStorage, key: string, state: SidebarState) => void

exports.name: SIDEBAR_SNAPSHOT_VERSION
exports.description: The current snapshot version. Bump it with a migration whenever the shape changes.

exports.name: SidebarSnapshot
exports.description: The persisted shape at the current version.

exports.name: SidebarStorage
exports.description: Something that stores strings by key: localStorage, a cookie, a server. Synchronous so the first render has the state (S123).

exports.name: SnapshotRecord
exports.description: A plain JSON object (what a migration reads and returns).

exports.name: SIDEBAR_MIGRATIONS
exports.description:
Migration from version `from` to `from + 1`. History:
- v1 (first draft): `{ v: 1, open: boolean, width: number, expanded: string[] }` — `open` was the inverse of `collapsed`.
- v2: `collapsed` replaced `open`; `sections` held the collapsed section ids.
- v3: `sections` renamed `collapsedSections`; `showAll`, `hiddenSections`, `panel` and `recents` added.

exports.name: ParsedSnapshot
exports.description: The outcome of reading a snapshot: the state, and why defaults were used when they were.

exports.name: resolveMessages
exports.description: The defaults with `partial` on top (the badge messages merge one level deeper).

exports.name: SidebarMessages
exports.description: Every built-in string the sidebar shows or announces; pass a partial to the provider's `messages` prop to translate it.

exports.name: DEFAULT_SIDEBAR_MESSAGES
exports.description: The English defaults that `resolveMessages` merges a partial over.

exports.name: sourceIdOf
exports.description: The source item id of a derived row id (`favorites::api` → `api`); the id itself when it is not derived.

exports.name: favoritesSection
exports.description:
The Favourites section (S31): every item flagged `favorite`, in nav order,
a starred folder with its subtree (S34). A favourite inside a starred
folder is listed once, under the folder.

exports.name: recentsSection
exports.description:
The Recents section (S33): the items of `recents` (newest first, the store's
`recents`) that still exist, without their children, capped at `limit`
(default {@link RECENTS_MAX}).
exports.signature: <T>(sections: readonly NavSection<T>[], recents: readonly string[], options: DerivedSectionOptions) => NavSection<T>

exports.name: DERIVED_ID_SEPARATOR
exports.description: Joins a derived section's id and the source item's id.

exports.name: DerivedSectionOptions
exports.description: What a derived section is called and says when it is empty.

exports.name: rowOffsets
exports.description: `offsets[i]` is the top of row `i`; the last entry is the total height (length = rows + 1).

exports.name: rowAt
exports.description: The first row whose bottom is below `y` (the row at that pixel); `count` when `y` is past the end.

exports.name: virtualWindow
exports.description:
The rows visible between `scrollTop` and `scrollTop + viewport` (both in the
list's own coordinates: subtract where the list starts inside its scroller),
widened by `overscan` rows each way. Indexes are absolute, so a rendered row
keeps its real position for `aria-posinset`, the dnd index and keyboard moves.
exports.signature: (offsets: Float64Array, scrollTop: number, viewport: number, overscan: number) => VirtualWindow

exports.name: scrollToRow
exports.description: The scrollTop (list coordinates) that brings row `index` fully into a `viewport`-tall view, or null when it already is.
exports.signature: (offsets: Float64Array, index: number, scrollTop: number, viewport: number) => number | null

exports.name: VirtualWindow
exports.description: Which rows to render: `[start, end)` as indexes into the full row list, and the spacer heights around them.

exports.name: localStorageAdapter
exports.description: `localStorage`, or nothing when it is absent (the server) or blocked.

exports.name: memoryStorage
exports.description: A map in memory; `seed` pre-fills it.
exports.signature: (seed?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) => SidebarStorage & { readonly entries: () => ReadonlyMap<string, string>; }

exports.name: cookieStorage
exports.description: One cookie per key, URI-encoded; reads `header` when there is no document.

exports.name: COOKIE_MAX_AGE_S
exports.description: Cookie lifetime, seconds: a year, like shadcn's sidebar cookie.

exports.name: CookieStorageOptions
exports.description: Options for `cookieStorage`.

exports.name: bandFor
exports.description: The band for a viewport `width`.

exports.name: watchBand
exports.description: Calls `onChange` with the band now and whenever it changes; returns the stop function. No-op without `matchMedia`.
exports.signature: (onChange: (band: Band) => void, breakpoints?: BandBreakpoints, win?: Window | null) => () => void

exports.name: prefersReducedMotion
exports.description: True when the user asked for reduced motion (the width transition turns off, S22).

exports.name: BandBreakpoints
exports.description: Viewport widths (px) where each band starts.

exports.name: DEFAULT_BREAKPOINTS
exports.description: Tailwind's `md` (768) and `lg` (1024) widths, used when no breakpoints are passed.

exports.name: createHoverIntent
exports.description: A hover intent calling `onChange` when the open state flips (tests drive it with fake timers).
exports.signature: (onChange: (open: boolean) => void, options?: { readonly enterMs?: number; readonly leaveMs?: number; }) => HoverIntent

exports.name: PEEK_ENTER_MS
exports.description: Rest time before a peek opens, ms (Notion's and Arc's feel).

exports.name: PEEK_LEAVE_MS
exports.description: Grace time before a peek closes after the pointer leaves, ms.

exports.name: HoverIntent
exports.description: A delayed open/close controller for the hover-peek and rail flyouts; made by `createHoverIntent`.

exports.name: SidebarModeOverride
exports.description: Forces the visible mode for its subtree (the ui layer's sheet, `SidebarLayout`'s overlay layer).

exports.name: SidebarProvider
exports.description: Provides one sidebar's state; see the file header.

props.name: children
props.description: The sidebar layout and anything else that reads this sidebar's state.

props.name: store
props.description: The host's own store (shared with a router, a devtools panel); default one made from `defaultState` and `persist`.

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Starting state merged under the persisted snapshot.

props.name: persist
props.description: Where the UI state is saved and loaded from; omit to keep it in memory only.

props.name: collapse
props.description: What "collapsed" means (S2–S4).

props.name: side
props.description: Which edge (S10).

props.name: railWidth
props.description: Icon rail width in px; default {@link RAIL_WIDTH_PX}, or {@link RAIL_LABELS_WIDTH_PX} for the `rail-labels` mode.

props.name: breakpoints
props.description: Band breakpoints (S86): Tailwind's `md` / `lg`, `{ tablet: 768, desktop: 1024 }`, unless given.

props.name: band
props.description: Force a band (tests, a phone preview frame); default from the viewport.

props.name: icons
props.description: Icon registry for `{ name }` icons (icons are data in the core); none are registered unless given.

props.name: location
props.description: The current location, for active matching (S121); pass the router's pathname.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark; default "Sidebar".

props.description:
The built-in ⌘B / Ctrl+B toggle (S94) for hosts without the

props.name: messages
props.description: Built-in strings and announcements, merged over the English defaults (S113).

exports.name: useForcedMode
exports.description: The mode forced on this subtree (the sheet and the overlay layer force `panel`), or null when none is.

exports.name: useSidebar
exports.description: This sidebar's state and actions (collapsed, mode, band, width, toggle and the rest); call it inside a `SidebarProvider`.

exports.name: useSidebarContext
exports.description: The provider's value; throws outside a `SidebarProvider` (a setup error, never a runtime state).

exports.name: useSidebarMode
exports.description: What a part inside the sidebar should draw: `panel`, `rail`, `hidden` or `sheet`, honouring an override.

exports.name: useSidebarSelector
exports.description: A slice of the state; re-renders only when `select` returns a different value (`Object.is`).

exports.name: visibleMode
exports.description: The visible mode for a band, collapse mode and collapsed flag (pure; exported for tests and custom layouts).
exports.signature: (band: Band, collapse: CollapseMode, collapsed: boolean) => SidebarApi["mode"]

exports.name: SidebarApi
exports.description: The everyday API: the visible mode and the actions.

exports.name: SidebarContextValue
exports.description: What the context holds; components use the hooks below, not this.

exports.name: SidebarIconComponent
exports.description: An icon component in the host's registry: lucide, heroicons or the host's own.

exports.name: SidebarPersistOptions
exports.description: Persistence options: the storage and the key the snapshot lives under.
